terms.meaning: a visual move, scale or slide applied to an element without changing its layout

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Progress track and fill
sections.what: Draws the background track and the moving fill, and moves the fill to match the value.
sections.why: Likely reason: sliding the fill is smooth and cheap for the browser to animate.
sections.watch_out: The value is not clamped, so out-of-range numbers push the bar outside its track.

summary: Shows a horizontal bar that fills from left to right to show how far a task has progressed.
purpose: Gives visual progress feedback during loading or multi-step work.
why: Likely reason: it wraps a progress library and applies the app's colours.
how: Draws a rounded track in a light tint. Inside it, a bar is shifted left by the part not yet done, so a full value shows the whole bar and an empty value shows none.
inputs: A value number (a missing value counts as 0), plus style overrides.
outputs: A progress bar displayed in the page.
risks: The value is not checked, so numbers above 100 or below 0 will show the bar past its edges.
debug: If the bar looks wrong, check the value passed in is between 0 and 100.
